desc: Princess exists as a ROLE in the banquet plot
during reception, the Princess greets the Guests
during feast, the Princess refuses to eat unless she likes the food
Pretender exists as a ROLE and initially behaves as a Guest
during feast, the Pretender can talk to other Guests
during feast, if no food is to her liking, the Princess asks the Pretender to search
the Pretender checks around for available food
on finding an appropriate dish, gives it to the Princess, ENDING the quest
during feast, the Princess can ask the Pretender to dance, starting a Ball
during the Ball, the Pretender FORGETS its other duties and only talks with her
a Guest greeted by the Princess becomes enamoured
a Guest who spoke with the Pretender becomes its friend
during the Ball, a friendly Guest cheers the couple
during the Ball, an enamoured Guest insults the couple, starting a duel
a Guest that is neither or both just watches
